profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Shape Security

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Developed scripts in Golang to update Powerwalls configuration on fleets of over 2000 customers, ensuring 100% uptime of Powerwalls.
● Optimized error handling of communication between battery gateways and PostgreSQL DBs by more than 60% utilizing Golang.
● Extended mobile app API to smooth charted data by over 3X through implementation of a smothing algorithm using Golang, minimizing visiblity of data artifacts.
● Led development of Gridlogic API built utilizing JavaScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL on team of 3 engineers, enabling creation of users, contracts, and networks for major customers (ex: PG&E, Green Mountain Power).
● Wrote > 30 BDD integration tests with Python and Behave to verify quality and compatibility with company services and APIs, resulting in 20% improvement in the mobile app data visualization API and battery configuration synchronization system.
● Assisted engineer lead in integrating Tesla services to Gridlogic UI, optimizing graph rendering of data by 25%.
● Worked extensively to translate Powerwall install wizard to Spanish, directly assisting the company’s push for
Puerto Rico power outage relief.

positions.title: Grant Writer + Executive Assistant
positions.description:
- Generated $1,000,000+ in new grant proposals through weaving factual evidence into effective “storytelling.”
- Optimized relational donor database of 3,000+ entries by reducing inactive members accounts by ~50%. 
- Increased donors by > 20% per appeal by utilizing web and social media platforms to expand audience reach.

projects.title: Cloud Collab
projects.description:
Real-time code collaboration tool for software engineers to work together remotely on open sourced Github repositories.
- Reduced front-end codebase by ~25% following ReactJS best practices and using ES6 classes to modularize the views into reusable components.
- Saved engineering team ~10 hours weekly in debugging front-end views through incorporating Redux into ReactJS components for predictable state management.
- Minimized HTTP requests to Node.js server by ~75% through utilizing React-Router for front-end routing.
- Engineered real-­time low latency editing and link sharing in > 1 sec with Ace Editor, Socket.IO and WebRTC.
- Integrated Github API into Node.js backend to render user repository contents for simultaneous editing.
- Utilized the Webpack build tool to compile ES6 with Babel into ES5 bundle script served by an Express server.

projects.title: Quest
projects.description:
Immersive scavenger hunt experience where players can take photos with their mobile device to complete specific goals.
- Improved by ~93% camera image load speed and transition between mobile views by refactoring routing between React Native components to follow system architecture best practices.
- Dynamically generated photo tags using Clarify API for image analysis to enable scavenger hunt checklist. 
- Stored tags and user progress in Firebase DB and used Cloudinary for image persistence of up to 75,000 items.
